pages.text: A $(thing)Tobacco Box$() stores one exact type/batch of finished or loose tobacco while preserving its metadata. Supported contents are Cigars, Cigarettes, Shisha Tobacco, all six Loose Tobacco varieties, and Blended Tobacco.
Capacity depends on content:$(br2)$(item)Cigars:$() 8$(br)$(item)Cigarettes:$() 12$(br)$(item)Shisha Tobacco:$() 16$(br)$(item)Loose Tobacco:$() 16
pages.title: Capacities

pages.text: To insert, hold the box in one hand and a supported product in the other, then use the box; or right-click items onto the box inside an inventory. The first item defines what exact batch the box accepts. Later contents must match its stored components/processing data.
pages.title: Inserting

pages.text: Sneak-right-click the box to extract one item into your inventory. In an inventory, right-clicking the box onto an empty slot also extracts one. If the box is in your offhand and your main hand is empty, using/swinging can draw one item into the main hand.
pages.title: Extracting
Create Auto-Packing
pages.text: With Create, keep a Tobacco Box on a $(item)Depot$() beneath a Deployer and feed matching finished products into the Deployer. Each application packs the box without losing metadata. Attribute Filters expose $(thing)Box fill: Empty / Partially Filled / Full$(), so filtered Funnels can feed empty boxes and remove full ones automatically.
